current_definition: protocol-resolved Time_Takeover_Request (26 multi-TOR trials resolved by the protocol rule; 6 unresolved)
provenance_source: R1 ingestion; R2B populations (TOR_ANCHORED 492); D003 dictionary
uncertainty_representation: event timestamp at 20 Hz; multi-TOR sensitivity (R2B, 472 single-TOR)
human_review_note: Same event in R2 and R3 (TOR = clock origin). Multi-TOR rule does not change conclusions (R2B, R2C).

current_definition: Manual_Start − TOR (mode-switch event marker)
blocked_reason: estimates TOR → authority transfer only under the documented (unverified) Manual_Start design intent; never a braking or control-input time
uncertainty_representation: empirical distribution; within-participant exposure slope −0.033 s/exposure (95% CI −0.058, −0.007)
human_review_note: Must not be mapped onto t1 (effective braking) or authority transfer.

current_definition: TOR → effective human braking command (R3B model quantity)
blocked_reason: effective braking onset not observable: control channels not driver-only (B17)
provenance_source: R3B §3 / registry P02; lower end = R157 Annex 3 benchmark (not a takeover measurement)
uncertainty_representation: explicit assumption interval; dominant driver of R3B width
human_review_note: No D003 or public source identifies it for takeovers; t_button, Manual_Start and meta-analysis takeover time are different quantities.

current_definition: brake actuation delay after the braking command
provenance_source: registry P08; S20 (prior-phase record), S01, S04
human_review_note: Generic passenger-car evidence, not the D003 vehicle.

current_definition: deceleration build-up time (human pedal application × vehicle)
blocked_reason: human pedal dynamics dominate; vehicle-only t3 not separable; D003 brake channel not driver-only (B17)
provenance_source: registry P09; informed by S02, S04
human_review_note: Informed by, not measured from, instrumented stops.

current_definition: first human input on any control, whatever its effect (E_first_human_input)
blocked_reason: latent: first channel activity is not attributable to the driver (B17)
human_review_note: E_first_channel_activity is observable but is not this event.

current_definition: first human input that changes motion on a channel the human has authority over
human_review_note: Identical to t1 only inside the R3B model.

current_definition: instant the automation's longitudinal command ends and the driver's command becomes the one applied (exclusive handover)
usable_in_r3b: YES (at effective control, or f·t1 with f ∈ [0, 1])
blocked_reason: not directly observable; documented design intent: Manual_Start switches to manual mode and enables manual inputs (dictionary; S17); behaviour unverified
human_review_note: Must not be equated with TOR. Candidate: Manual_Start under documented design intent, pending internal verification.

current_definition: fraction u of vehicle braking capability commanded after effective control
usable_in_future_synthesis: NO as behaviour; CONDITIONAL as capability bound
blocked_reason: driver braking strength not observable (B17); crash evidence abstract-level and other context
human_review_note: u = 1 is a bound, not observed behaviour.

current_definition: net deceleration between TOR and effective human braking; policy before authority, vehicle-only after
usable_in_r3b: YES (P0/P1/P2 branches; drag source-supported, a_sup assumed)
blocked_reason: D003 vehicle kinematics observable but window (effective control) and authorship of actuation undocumented (B17 cell-specific pattern)
provenance_source: R3A §4; R3B §2; EPA drag (S07); registry P03, P06, P25

current_definition: braking capability on a reference surface
blocked_reason: D003 maximum deceleration is achieved kinematics, not capability; vehicle undocumented

current_definition: tyre-road friction; caps braking at μg
human_review_note: μ = 0.5 is a scenario assumption, not a wet-road measurement.

current_definition: ego speed at TOR
provenance_source: R2A vehicle_speed_at_tor (median 25.0 m/s, 19.2–27.8, n = 492); R3B grid

current_definition: distance to collision / ego speed; T_available^brake at TOR (constant-velocity reference)
human_review_note: TTC alone is not the hazard state.

current_definition: gap from ego to hazard station
validated lane-crossing time (the observable is the crossing, not the onset of steering)
blocked_reason: steering onset not attributable (B17); geometry and gaps unknown (B10, B5)
provenance_source: R1/R2A validated lane change; TOR → lane change median 6.40 s, IQR 5.45–7.70, n = 477
human_review_note: Not effective longitudinal control; not steering onset.

current_definition: no validated definition (T_stable withdrawn)
blocked_reason: no defensible completion/stabilisation definition within the handback window
human_review_note: Needs a definition before any S2/S3 outcome.

current_definition: first Time_Manual_Stop after Manual_Start; protocol competing event / observation boundary
blocked_reason: 12 trials with multiple values (B14); protocol-driven, not recovery completion
provenance_source: R2B handback: TOR → handback median 18.85 s
human_review_note: Must not be read as recovery completion or stabilisation.

current_definition: whether a collision-free lateral path exists over the manoeuvre window
usable_in_future_synthesis: NO until geometry and gaps are identified
blocked_reason: hazard geometry (B10), laneGap semantics (B5), adjacent-lane zero semantics unresolved
human_review_note: D003 drivers changed lanes in 499/513 trials: an escape path existed in practice, but it cannot be parameterised.

current_definition: self-reported experience, mileage, driving and ADAS frequency
blocked_reason: no association survives Holm; secondary re-analysis; questionnaire-id join strongly supported but not explicit

current_definition: within-participant trial position 1–9
human_review_note: Modest; not explained by carry-over; not causal learning.
